statement: Pinned Nunchuk page reports that Nintendo games determine analog-stick center on startup or insertion and explicitly says the mechanism is unknown. This page does not establish a factory calibration layout at 0xA40020 or 0xA40030. Dolphin's authored 0x20 template and rnconrad's duplicate 0x30 template remain emulator evidence rather than authenticated Nunchuk register contents.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Nunchuck > Data Format; Wireless Nunchuks. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Compare wii-gap-dolphin-nunchuk-calibration-layout, wii-gap-rnconrad-calibration-duplicate-registers and wii-gap-extension-calibration-checksum-unknown. The wireless-accessory anecdotes cannot be generalized to official wired Nunchuk.
